reason: Replacement for a false predecessor: the previous claim that every weight of O_Gamma lies below a maximal label fails for g=sl3, lambda=rho, Gamma=W.rho minus {rho} (incomparable maximal labels). This statement keeps only the true maximality consequences (no weight strictly above the maximal label; maximal-label vectors are singular; the weight functor is exact on h-semisimple modules), proved via composition-factor labels and exactness of weight spaces; sources Etingof Prop. 16.4 proof p. 86 and Lin Chen L8 Lemma 4.10 pp. 7-8, both fetch-verified.
